purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19302 (FBS-226) driving rcf verify run --package and --artefact --offline through bin/rcf.js over a fixture package repository, so the FBS-226 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against pack and install policy.
title: rcf verify run --package <dir>: pack from a committed HEAD, given-tarball provenance without pack, install failure exits 1 with the log, --offline and default registry policy recorded, no tarball or install output left in the project

testCases.description: rcf verify run --package . --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier at clean head H packs with npm pack into the scratch directory, exits 0 and prints "verify report: rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/<head12>.json PASS 2/2"; target sha256 equals a separate npm pack of H, servedSha H, pack { command, exitCode 0 }
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/suite-as-probe-pack.test.js::AC-19302-1: rcf verify run --package . --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier at clean head H packs with npm pack into the scratch directory, exits 0 and prints "verify report: rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/<head12>.json PASS 2/2"; target sha256 equals a separate npm pack of H, servedSha H, pack { command, exitCode 0 }

testCases.description: rcf verify run --artefact fixture-cli-0.9.0.tgz --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier at head H records target.version 0.9.0, the tarball sha256, servedSha null and no pack object, and an npm wrapper on PATH logs install and never pack
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/suite-as-probe-pack.test.js::AC-19302-2: rcf verify run --artefact fixture-cli-0.9.0.tgz --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier at head H records target.version 0.9.0, the tarball sha256, servedSha null and no pack object, and an npm wrapper on PATH logs install and never pack

testCases.description: rcf verify run --artefact <tgz> --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier --offline with an unresolvable dependency exits 1 with stderr "verify run: install failed (npm exit <n>); log rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/<head12>/install.log", the log exists and no report JSON is written
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/suite-as-probe-pack.test.js::AC-19302-3: rcf verify run --artefact <tgz> --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier --offline with an unresolvable dependency exits 1 with stderr "verify run: install failed (npm exit <n>); log rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/<head12>/install.log", the log exists and no report JSON is written

testCases.description: rcf verify run --artefact <tgz> --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier with --offline then without exits 0 both times; install.command carries --offline only on the first, install.registry offline then default; rcf build finalise never installs or reaches the network
